answers: Setup answers, already given by the user: the project is Fieldnote (codename fieldnote); file naming is kebab-case, unnumbered; golden examples live at fixtures/golden/<id>/; tier standard; profile library-sdk-cli.
brainstorm: Brainstorm decisions, already made with the user: Fieldnote turns a folder of dated markdown notes about places into a searchable static site; it is for people who write one note per visit; the hard part is the note model (optional frontmatter, date falling back to the filename, inconsistent tags); the alternatives were a hand-kept index page or a general static-site generator; not built in v1: browser editing, sync between machines, a plugin system. Stack, settled: Python 3.11 or later, markdown-it-py for rendering, PyYAML for frontmatter, Jinja2 for templates, output is a static folder hosted anywhere. Open questions left: whether a note with no date at all is indexed as undated or rejected; whether v1 has client-side search.
